commands.label: real (first 60 s; video → 1080p30 H.264; audio -c:a copy)
commands.command: ffmpeg -hide_banner -loglevel error -y -ss 0 -t 60 -i <REAL-DIR>/<REAL-FILE> -map 0:v:0 -map 0:a:0 -vf scale=1920:1080:force_original_aspect_ratio=decrease,pad=1920:1080:(ow-iw)/2:(oh-ih)/2,fps=30 -c:v libx264 -preset veryfast -crf 23 -pix_fmt yuv420p -g 30 -c:a copy -movflags +faststart <TMP>/project/assets/main.mp4
